ingredients.title: Protein
items: 3 lb chicken breast (~6 medium, cut into chunks)

ingredients.title: Pasta & Grains
items: ¼ - ½ cup all-purpose flour (for tots & breading)

ingredients.title: Vegetables & Misc
items: 5 medium russet potatoes (~2 lb, for tater tots)

instructions.title: Spicy Chicken Nuggets
items: Cut chicken into 1.5–2 chunks, season with salt, paprika, garlic powder, and cayenne.
Coat each piece in flour, dip in beaten eggs, then breadcrumbs.
Fry or bake until golden and crispy.

instructions.title: Tater Tots
items: Peel potatoes, boil until tender, mash lightly.
Form into tots, coat lightly with flour and breadcrumbs.
Fry or bake until crispy and golden.

instructions.title: Mac & Cheese
items: Melt butter, whisk in flour, gradually add milk until thickened.
Stir in cheddar and mozzarella until creamy.

instructions.title: Bacon & Pepperoni
items: Slice pepperoni and crisp lightly in a skillet.
Layer over mac & cheese and tater tots.

instructions.title: Jalapeño Poppers
items: Halve jalapeños, remove seeds, mix cream cheese with paprika & garlic powder.
Fill jalapeños, coat with breadcrumbs, bake or fry until golden.

instructions.title: Assembling
items: Layer mac & cheese, chicken nuggets, tater tots, bacon, pepperoni, and jalapeño poppers in a large casserole dish.
Bake at 350°F for 15–20 min until everything is warmed through.
Serve immediately with optional pickle slices.

storage: Refrigerate leftovers in airtight container for up to 4 days.
Freeze individual portions for up to 2 months.
Reheat in oven at 325°F or microwave until hot.
serving_suggestions: Add extra shredded cheese on top for gooeyness.
Serve with sour cream, salsa, or dipping sauces.
Pair with soft rolls or biscuits for a hearty meal.
Top with cinnamon toast crunch for crunch.
